_source: Standalone Statement of Profit and Loss, PDF page 253 of annual-report-2025-2026.pdf (Tata Consultancy Services Integrated Annual Report 2025-26).
_unit: INR crore, exactly as printed. No rescaling. Brackets are negative.
_method: Read from the printed statement via `pdftotext -table`, independent of the pipeline's Azure Document Intelligence OCR. Every subtotal re-derived by hand and ties: 230974-164101=66873; 66873-4067=62806; 62806-13710=49096; 49096+(-600)=48496.
_pbmi_note: PBMI is 48,496 = PATR 49,096 plus OCI (-600). It is total COMPREHENSIVE income before minority interest, NOT profit after tax. An earlier hand-read ground truth recorded 49,096 here; that was the truth set being wrong, not the extractor -- see the note-driven design section 7.2.
_coverage: FACE-LEVEL ONLY, deliberately partial. Same convention as the consolidated file: a tag is listed only where its mapping to a printed line is unambiguous, and tags in NEITHER list are out of scope and ignored by score_document.
